title: Operational Concept for the Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System

sections.heading: Regional Operating Context and Mission Need
sections.topic: Describe the Meridian region, its congested airport network, recurring flow constraints, and the operational mission for a shared ATFM and A-CDM capability.

sections.heading: System Boundary and Stakeholder Participation
sections.topic: Define the system boundary, participating airports, service providers, airlines, handlers, and the initial naming of the core regional platform used throughout the concept.

sections.heading: Daily Planning Cycle and Pre-Tactical Baseline
sections.topic: Explain how the morning plan is built from schedules, weather outlooks, capacity declarations, and early runway and stand readiness information.

sections.heading: Flow Management Roles and Accountability
sections.topic: Set out the responsibilities of regional flow staff, network liaisons, meteorological briefers, and escalation contacts during pre-tactical and tactical operations.

sections.heading: Demand, Weather, and Capacity Inputs
sections.topic: Describe the forecast services and weather gateways that feed the capacity picture and explain how forecast confidence is recorded.

sections.heading: Airline Operations Centre Integration
sections.topic: Explain how airline operations centres submit intents, receive constraints, and coordinate crew, aircraft, and passenger recovery actions.

sections.heading: Airport Collaborative Decision Portal Concept
sections.topic: Describe the shared A-CDM portal, user workspaces, milestone views, and the obligations for timely update by each airport participant.

sections.heading: Tower and Airport Duty Coordination
sections.topic: Describe the coordination between the tower, airport duty desk, surface surveillance feeds, and operational safety checks.

sections.heading: Ramp Control and Apron Movement Management
sections.topic: Explain ramp control responsibilities for pushback sequencing, towing priorities, apron occupancy, and coordination with handling planners.

sections.heading: Slot Allocation Principles and Governance
sections.topic: Define slot allocation priorities, fairness rules, exemption handling, and the engine that proposes regulated departure and arrival opportunities.

sections.heading: Collaborative Target Time Management
sections.topic: Explain how target off-block times, calculated takeoff times, and milestone timestamps are proposed, negotiated, frozen, and audited.

sections.heading: Tower Sequencing and Departure Readiness
sections.topic: Describe the tower sequence workflow, runway queue management, departure readiness checks, and deicing interface points.

sections.heading: Ground Handling and Resource Constraints
sections.topic: Explain how handler dispatch, tow teams, buses, loaders, and stand equipment shortages influence feasible off-block times.

sections.heading: Airspace Restrictions and Alerting
sections.topic: Describe military coordination, temporary restricted areas, alert routing, and the treatment of late airspace capacity changes.

sections.heading: Departure Metering and Queue Absorption
sections.topic: Explain how metering absorbs delay at stands, coordinates pushback windows, and prevents runway queues from exceeding agreed thresholds.

sections.heading: Deicing, Winter Operations, and Pad Coordination
sections.topic: Describe the winter operating mode, deicing pad queue controls, fluid status updates, and ramp-tower coordination under freezing conditions.

sections.heading: Arrival Regulation and Holding Avoidance
sections.topic: Explain arrival regulation options, airborne holding prevention, diversion triggers, and tactical landing-rate adjustments.

sections.heading: Integrated Tactical Management Position
sections.topic: Describe the combined tactical display where departure, arrival, airport, and airspace measures are monitored and adjusted in real time.

sections.heading: Surface Constraints and Equipment Advisories
sections.topic: Explain how surface equipment conditions, fuel vehicle holds, runway metering, and apron congestion advisories affect the tactical plan.

sections.heading: Stand, Gate, and Passenger Connection Recovery
sections.topic: Describe how gate conflicts, stand reopening, passenger connection pressure, and aircraft turnaround recovery are coordinated.

sections.heading: Diversion and Irregular Operations Handling
sections.topic: Define diversion decision support, medical and technical priority cases, communication sequencing, and recovery coordination.

sections.heading: Baggage, Towbar, and Handler Exception Processing
sections.topic: Explain how late baggage, towbar availability, and handler exceptions are escalated without overwhelming the common operating picture.

sections.heading: Remote Stands and Landside Interface
sections.topic: Describe remote stand use, shuttle availability, passenger bus constraints, and the linkage between landside service limits and airside timing.

sections.heading: Border, Customs, and Apron Sensor Inputs
sections.topic: Explain how border release status, customs holds, and apron sensing data are represented in operational decisions.

sections.heading: Sector Load and En-Route Constraint Management
sections.topic: Describe how sector load monitors, departure fix saturation, and en-route constraints are converted into airport-level measures.

sections.heading: Crew Legality and Operator Recovery Choices
sections.topic: Explain how crew duty limits, aircraft operator preferences, and recovery options are represented without disclosing unnecessary commercial information.

sections.heading: Apron Cleanliness, Safety, and Readiness Checks
sections.topic: Describe apron sweeps, foreign object debris checks, stand readiness confirmation, and the timing of safety-related releases.

sections.heading: Slot Swaps and Collaborative Substitution
sections.topic: Define the controlled process for slot swaps, substitutions, customs releases, and airline-to-airline coordination under governance rules.

sections.heading: Lighting, Navaid, and Aerodrome Infrastructure Events
sections.topic: Describe how aerodrome infrastructure outages, lighting limits, and declared service reductions are published into the flow process.

sections.heading: Contingency Operations and Fallback Modes
sections.topic: Define degraded operations, contingency consoles, manual slot procedures, and the transition criteria into and out of fallback states.

sections.heading: Passenger Disruption Indicators and Service Recovery
sections.topic: Explain how passenger misconnection information and airline recovery actions inform metering choices without making passenger handling the primary system function.

sections.heading: Cybersecurity, Identity, and Access Control
sections.topic: Describe identity management, role-based access, operational segregation, audit expectations, and contingency access for emergency users.

sections.heading: Audit, Compliance, and Slot Performance Review
sections.topic: Explain how slot compliance, user decisions, substitutions, and late operational changes are audited for post-operations review.

sections.heading: Data Governance and Information Quality
sections.topic: Define data ownership, freshness indicators, validation rules, discrepancy resolution, and stewardship responsibilities.

sections.heading: Performance Measurement and Regional Benefits
sections.topic: Describe the operational metrics for delay absorption, queue length, slot adherence, cancellation avoidance, emissions reduction, and stakeholder benefit tracking.

sections.heading: Training, Exercises, and Human Factors
sections.topic: Explain controller, tower, ramp, airline, and handler training requirements, including simulation exercises and human factors safeguards.

sections.heading: Implementation Phasing and Airport Onboarding
sections.topic: Describe phased deployment, pilot airport selection, stakeholder readiness gates, interface certification, and migration from local tools.

sections.heading: Operational Service Management
sections.topic: Define support hours, incident handling, change windows, service level targets, and the relationship between system support and operational supervisors.

sections.heading: Future Enhancements and Regional Expansion
sections.topic: Identify future capabilities such as cross-border flow exchange, richer trajectory prediction, advanced turnaround prediction, and machine-assisted recovery options.

sections.heading: Summary of Operating Commitments
sections.topic: Summarize the commitments, decision rights, information-sharing duties, and governance principles required for sustained regional ATFM and A-CDM operation.

domain: a regional air traffic flow management and airport collaborative decision-making system (flow managers, airline operations centres, towers, ramp control, slot allocation)
